items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: I never listened to Serge Chaloff. I mean Serge died when I first started to play.

ctx.x: Serge Chaloff, yeah. People used to say “you must have listened to Serge—” I never listened to Serge Chaloff. I mean Serge died when I first started to play. And he didn’t record a lot of records. I heard about him, and the few times I heard him, he didn’t knock me out. I wasn’t too interested. I was like, well yeah he plays good, but I don’t know, it doesn’t knock me. out. But lately I’ve listened to him. I’ve listened to some records that were re-released and maybe I think there were records that maybe were…
Well you’ve been able to get together with some of your contemporaries on the baritone on some of your records, right?
